summary: Talisman: Digital Classic Edition - the iconic Games Workshop fantasy board game
description: Embark on a Perilous Fantasy Adventure! 🐉 Fight dragons, battle serpents, and avoid the deadly curse of the Hag in Talisman, the magical quest game from Games Workshop. Enjoyed by fantasy fans for nearly 30 years, this classic board game tests your skillful decision-making with dice and cards. Choose from 14 unique characters, including the Warrior, Assassin, Thief, and Wizard, each with their own strengths, weaknesses, and special powers. Race your opponents through a perilous realm to claim the coveted Crown of Command! Features: • Officially Licensed: Games Workshop game using the Revised 4th Edition rules with official artwork. • Fully Expandable: More expansions and characters available as in-app purchases. • Local Multiplayer: Pass to Play mode for fun with family and friends. • Real-Time Online Multiplayer: Compete against friends or players worldwide! • Expansion Sharing: As long as one player owns expansions, everyone else in the online lobby can use them too! • AI Opponents: Challenge AI characters in offline games. • Optional House Rules: Customize your gameplay experience. • Interactive Tutorial: Learn the game mechanics with ease. • XP Progression: Level-up and unlock special Runestone cards exclusive to the digital edition. • Achievements & Leaderboards: Compare your skills with players worldwide!
